blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Five Filipino seafarers aboard the Antigua-flagged bulk carrier M/V Cape Dao returned to Manila on Sept. 27, four days after the vessel was damaged while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The seafarers arrived on Qatar Airways flight QR928 at Terminal 3 of the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA), where they were received by officials from the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) and the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), along with medical teams from the Manila International Airport Authority and New NAIA Infra Corp.
